scope: ERC-20 v0.7.5 pre-release noops before the evm-balances-erc20-v0.7.5 tag. No ClickHouse writes, sink changes, API cutover or full-history qualification.
range_semantics: Start inclusive, stop exclusive. Production mode processes complete 1000-block segments; noops assert acceptance, not the correctness of every balance.
window_set: docs/prerelease-noop-windows.json as of this record: the 859 windows below.
how_it_ran: The run began on the untightened plan (587 windows, 48.8 million blocks: the 2026-10-29 native matrix as 100,000-block windows, continuous history since then and each final segment). At the owner's request it was stopped after 392 windows had passed, none failed, and the window set was tightened. Of the 859 tightened windows, those inside a passed 100,000-block run were covered by it; the others were run on their own. Each window below names the run that covered it.
why_these_suffice: v0.7.5 changes only the inference (src/infer.rs), which never fails a block; block validation and the persistence rules, the only sources of refusals, are those of v0.7.4. The noops check that the new inference code neither panics nor fails to decode on these blocks, including the 24 stale-holder blocks whose rows it changes.
